quiz_item.scenario_prompt: In Citizenship in the World Requirement 1, how does national sovereignty interact with international law and diplomacy when countries address cross-border challenges?
quiz_item.question: In Citizenship in the World Requirement 1, how does national sovereignty interact with international law and diplomacy when countries address cross-border challenges?
options: A. A single world legislature automatically writes domestic criminal laws and collects income taxes inside every country.
B. Sovereign nations are legally prohibited from signing trade agreements, environmental treaties, or mutual defense pacts.
C. International law only applies to uninhabited islands and has no relevance to maritime shipping, aviation, or diplomatic embassies.
D. Each sovereign state exercises supreme authority within its own territory, but nations voluntarily enter treaties.
choices: A. A single world legislature automatically writes domestic criminal laws and collects income taxes inside every country.
B. Sovereign nations are legally prohibited from signing trade agreements, environmental treaties, or mutual defense pacts.
C. International law only applies to uninhabited islands and has no relevance to maritime shipping, aviation, or diplomatic embassies.
D. Each sovereign state exercises supreme authority within its own territory, but nations voluntarily enter treaties.
quiz_item.correct_answer: D. Each sovereign state exercises supreme authority within its own territory, but nations voluntarily enter treaties.
quiz_item.explanation: Correct Answer (D): National sovereignty means a country governs its own internal affairs, while international law and diplomacy operate through treaties, conventions, and mutual cooperation among sovereign states.

options: A. A single world legislature automatically writes domestic criminal laws and collects income taxes inside every country.
B. Sovereign nations are legally prohibited from signing trade agreements, environmental treaties, or mutual defense pacts.
C. International law only applies to uninhabited islands and has no relevance to maritime shipping, aviation, or diplomatic embassies.
D. Each sovereign state exercises supreme authority within its own territory, but nations voluntarily enter treaties.
choices: A. A single world legislature automatically writes domestic criminal laws and collects income taxes inside every country.
B. Sovereign nations are legally prohibited from signing trade agreements, environmental treaties, or mutual defense pacts.
C. International law only applies to uninhabited islands and has no relevance to maritime shipping, aviation, or diplomatic embassies.
D. Each sovereign state exercises supreme authority within its own territory, but nations voluntarily enter treaties.
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: D. Each sovereign state exercises supreme authority within its own territory, but nations voluntarily enter treaties, diplomatic agreements, and international organizations (such as the UN) to resolve disputes and cooperate on trade, security, and humanitarian aid.
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (D): National sovereignty means a country governs its own internal affairs, while international law and diplomacy operate through treaties, conventions, and mutual cooperation among sovereign states.
